text_block_list.text:
—The final day of summer training camp. While waiting on a bench
for Rice Shower to finish packing to head back...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Brooother~~!
I'm so sorry to keep you waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Siisteer~~!
I'm so sorry to keep you waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haah... Ehehe.
I got so caught up helping out with various things that I stayed late...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This training camp took really good care
of us, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"So Rice asked the dorm manager
if there was anything Rice could do.
...Even if Rice only had a little bit of time."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true...
I only did a little bit, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Watering the flowers...
repainting the benches, and so on—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The bench that
Big Brother is resting on right now—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The bench that
Big Sister is resting on right now—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis!?
(Riiiiiiippp!!)

...I scrambled to my feet in a panic,
but wet paint was already smeared all over me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! It's because Rice
didn't put up a warning note...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa... What should I do?
Big Brother. Auuu~...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa... What should I do?
Big Sister. Auuu~...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... *sigh*...
I'm really sorry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll go apologize
to the dorm manager too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And borrow some paint too.
Then check what we need to do...

—Everyone has parts of themselves that never change.
Yet, there are parts that steadily grow.
That was what this final day made me feel.
